assessments_select_linked_professional.name: assessments_select_linked_professional
assessments_select_linked_professional.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.care_links cl
        where cl.patient_id = "assessments"."user_id"
          and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
          and cl.ended_at is null
          and (cl.shares_history or "assessments"."completed_at" >= cl.started_at)
      )

assistant_conversations_select_own.name: assistant_conversations_select_own
assistant_conversations_select_own.using:
"assistant_conversations"."owner_id" = (select auth.uid()) and ("assistant_conversations"."mode" = 'personal' or exists (
    select 1 from public.care_links cl
    join public.professional_profiles pp on pp.user_id = cl.professional_id
    where cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
      and cl.patient_id = "assistant_conversations"."patient_id"
      and cl.ended_at is null
      and pp.status = 'verified'
  ))

care_links_insert_by_patient.name: care_links_insert_by_patient
care_links_insert_by_patient.withCheck:
"care_links"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and "care_links"."ended_at" is null
        and public.current_account_type() = 'patient'
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.invitations i
          where i.id = "care_links"."invitation_id"
            and i.patient_id = (select auth.uid())
            and i.professional_id = "care_links"."professional_id"
            and i.status = 'accepted'
        )

care_links_end_by_participant.withCheck: ("care_links"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) or "care_links"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())) and "care_links"."ended_at" is not null

professional_documents_insert_own.name: professional_documents_insert_own
professional_documents_insert_own.withCheck:
"professional_documents"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and split_part("professional_documents"."path", '/', 1) = (select auth.uid())::text
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.professional_profiles p
          where p.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and p.status <> 'verified'
        )
        and exists (
          select 1 from storage.objects o
          where o.bucket_id = 'professional-documents' and o.name = "professional_documents"."path"
        )

professional_profiles_insert_own_pending.name: professional_profiles_insert_own_pending

support_tickets_insert_own.name: support_tickets_insert_own
support_tickets_insert_own.withCheck:
"support_tickets"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and "support_tickets"."status" = 'pending'
        and "support_tickets"."created_at" = now()
        and num_nulls("support_tickets"."taken_at", "support_tickets"."taken_by", "support_tickets"."closed_at", "support_tickets"."closed_by", "support_tickets"."closing_note") = 5
        and (
          "support_tickets"."requester_role" = 'patient'
          or exists (select 1 from public.professional_profiles p where p.user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        )
        and (
          "support_tickets"."attachment_path" is null
          or (
            split_part("support_tickets"."attachment_path", '/', 1) = (select auth.uid())::text
            and exists (
              select 1 from storage.objects o
              where o.bucket_id = 'support-attachments'
                and o.name = "support_tickets"."attachment_path"
                and o.metadata ->> 'mimetype' = "support_tickets"."attachment_type"
                and (o.metadata ->> 'size')::bigint = "support_tickets"."attachment_size"
            )
          )
        )

support_tickets_custom_subject.name: support_tickets_custom_subject
support_tickets_custom_subject.value:
("support_tickets"."subject" = 'other') = ("support_tickets"."custom_subject" is not null)
        and char_length("support_tickets"."custom_subject") between 3 and 120

support_tickets_attachment_size.name: support_tickets_attachment_size
support_tickets_attachment_size.value: "support_tickets"."attachment_size" between 1 and case when "support_tickets"."attachment_type" like 'image/%' then 5242880 else 2097152 end
